title: 等差數列\(\displaystyle \langle a_n\rangle\) , 已知  \(\displaystyle a_1=2\) 且公差為負實數\(\displaystyle d\)。試選出正確的選項。

options.note:
​考慮 \(a_{10} > 0\) 與 \(a_{100} < 0\) 能否同時存在 ​ ​\(\left\{ \begin{array}{} a_{10}=2+9d > 0 \\ a_{100}=2+99d < 0 \end{array}\right.\) \(\Rightarrow \)\(\left\{ \begin{array}{} d > \dfrac{-2}{9}\\ d < \dfrac{-2}{99}\end{array}\right.\)

\(\Rightarrow \)\(\dfrac{-2}{9} < d < \dfrac{-2}{99}\) 範圍合法, 可找到反例​​

​考慮 \(a_{100} > 0\) 與 \(a_{10} < 0\) 能否同時存在

​ ​\(\left\{ \begin{array}{} a_{100}=2+99d > 0 \\ a_{10}=2+9d < 0 \end{array}\right.\)

\(\Rightarrow \)\(\left\{ \begin{array}{} d > \dfrac{-2}{99}\\ d < \dfrac{-2}{9}\end{array}\right.\)

\(\Rightarrow \)\(\dfrac{-2}{99} < d < \dfrac{-2}{9}\) 範圍不合法, 無反例​​

options.text: 若 \(\displaystyle \langle c_n\rangle\) 為 \(\displaystyle a_1, a_2, a_3, \cdots, a_n\) 的算術平均數, 則 \(\displaystyle c_1, c_2, c_3, \cdots\) 是公差為 \(\displaystyle d\) 的等差數列​​
options.note:
已知\(c_1=a_1\) 且 \(c_3=\dfrac{a_1+a_2+a_3}{3}=a_2\)​​

\(\Rightarrow\)\(c_3-c_2=a_2-a_1=d\)​​

可知 \(\langle c_n \rangle\)公差為 \(\dfrac{d}{2}\)
